avis.titre: Cute Bottle, but No Miraculous Results
avis.texte: This brand is definitely taking off! I needed eye cream ASAP and saw this eye cream at Ulta. The price and dozens of raving reviews online for this eye cream made purchasing it a no-brainer. I love the aesthetic of this brand, it's very refreshing. I used this eye cream when I was on a trip. The bottle is TSA compliant. However, when I look back, I don't remember receiving any miraculous results from using this eye cream. I will write this in every eye cream review I post: If you're trying to reduce the appearance of your under eyes, do not depend solely on an eye cream to do that for you - prioritizing sleep is the main answer. In other words, if you're already getting at least eight hours of sleep per night but are still concerned about how your under eyes look, then this product will not provide you with the miraculous results you're expecting. Look elsewhere if you want tangible results.
It is good it you need a little hydration, I have oily skin so it does the job. But if you have more needs I do not recommend it.
